PROHIBITION OF SALE OF CIGARETTES TO
PROHIBITION OF SALE OF CIGARETTES TO
MINORS RULES, 2010
(Amendment of R. 3(3))
[Gazette of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part II,
3rd April, 2018]
S.R.O.
415(I)/2018, dated 22.3.2018.---In
exercise of the powers conferred by section 17 of the Prohibition of Smoking
and Protection of Non-Smokers Ordinance, 2002 (LXXIV of 2002), the Federal
Government is pleased to direct that the following amendment shall be made in
the Prohibition of Sale of Cigarettes to Minors Rules, 2010, namely:--
In
the aforesaid Rules, in rule 3, after sub-rule (3) the following new sub-rule
shall be added, namely:-
"(4)
No retail seller or any person shall sell, offer for sale or distribute any
cigarettes unless they are in a packet of at least twenty cigarette
sticks.".
